items.headline: Wemby Drops 43 as Spurs Dominate Wolves
items.summary: Victor Wembanyama exploded for a career-high 43 points, along with 7 rebounds and 6 blocks, leading the San Antonio Spurs to a decisive 121-111 victory over the Minnesota Timberwolves. His dominant performance showcased his elite two-way potential.

items.headline: Avdija Leads Blazers to Victory Over Jazz
items.summary: Israeli forward Deni Avdija delivered a strong performance, scoring 24 points to go with 5 rebounds, 2 assists, and 1 steal, as the Portland Trail Blazers bounced back with a 112-90 win against the Utah Jazz. Damian Lillard added 22 points for Portland.

items.headline: 76ers Hold Off Hornets
items.summary: Tyrese Maxey's 38 points propelled the Philadelphia 76ers to a 109-104 victory over the Charlotte Hornets. Anfernee Simons chipped in 19 points off the bench for the Sixers, who rested LeBron James and Joel Embiid.

items.headline: Cavaliers Roll Past Bucks
items.summary: Evan Mobley scored 27 points and Jarrett Allen added 25 points and 11 rebounds as the Cleveland Cavaliers defeated the Milwaukee Bucks 136-111, securing their first road win of the season.

items.headline: Pelicans Beat Hawks
items.summary: Saddiq Bey led the New Orleans Pelicans with 25 points in a reserve role, contributing to their 121-99 win over the Atlanta Hawks. The Pelicans claimed their second straight victory.

items.headline: Rockets Down Thunder
items.summary: The Houston Rockets secured a 119-98 victory over the Oklahoma City Thunder. Jabari Smith Jr. led the Rockets with 30 points.

items.headline: Warriors Stun Lakers in Cup Opener
items.summary: The Golden State Warriors overcame a 25-point deficit to defeat the Los Angeles Lakers 112-95 in their first NBA Cup game. Stephen Curry scored 31 points, while Luka Doncic had 37 for the Lakers in the losing effort.

items.headline: Celtics Extend Win Streak vs Bulls
items.summary: The Boston Celtics extended their winning streak to four games with a 125-111 victory over the Chicago Bulls. Peyton Pritchard led the Celtics with 30 points.

items.headline: Magic Top Raptors
items.summary: Desmond Bane's 28 points helped the Orlando Magic to a 121-114 win against the Toronto Raptors, despite a 41-point effort from Scottie Barnes.

items.headline: Pistons Defeat Nets
items.summary: The Detroit Pistons secured a 110-94 win over the Brooklyn Nets, who remain winless after five consecutive defeats. Cade Cunningham contributed 20 points for the Pistons.

items.headline: Lakers Face Injury Woes Ahead of Raptors Matchup
items.summary: The Los Angeles Lakers are managing a few injuries as they prepare to host the Toronto Raptors today. Ziaire Williams is questionable with left foot and heel injuries, while Adou Thiero remains out with a left knee injury. Rookie Cameron Carr, however, could make his NBA debut.

items.headline: Warriors Rest Stars for Clippers Game
items.summary: The Golden State Warriors will be without Stephen Curry (right knee) and Draymond Green (back) for their Sunday game against the LA Clippers, opting for rest on the first night of a back-to-back. Kristaps Porzingis, Jimmy Butler, and Moses Moody are also out due to various injuries.

items.headline: NBA Cup Group Play Continues
items.summary: The NBA's in-season tournament, the NBA Cup, continues with group play games through November. The Knockout Rounds are scheduled from December 4-11, with the championship game on December 11.

items.headline: Memphis Grizzlies Lead Western Conference Early
items.summary: The Memphis Grizzlies have set an early pace in the Western Conference, maintaining an unbeaten record. Meanwhile, the Detroit Pistons and Philadelphia 76ers are sharing the top spot in the Eastern Conference standings.

items.headline: Today's Key Matchups (Nov 1)
items.summary: Today's NBA slate includes the Los Angeles Lakers hosting the Toronto Raptors at Crypto.com Arena, and the Indiana Pacers facing the Brooklyn Nets in Indianapolis, with the Nets looking for their first win of the season.
